Даты отчётов — из финансовых календарей эмитентов: внесены вручную или прочитаны со страницы календаря («(автоматически)» в источнике; `оценка` — дата не подтверждена эмитентом). Реакция цены: отчёт до открытия — close дня отчёта к close предыдущей сессии; после закрытия — close следующей сессии к close дня отчёта; до close — «ждём close MM-DD». Δ кап. ≈ реакция цены × средневзвешенное число акций последнего года × close перед отчётом; без числа акций в структурированных данных — `—`. ### Siemens — 2026-11-09 — «Siemens to expand portfolio for semiconductor design and verification with the planned acquisition of Lauterbach»

> “With Lauterbach, we are further extending our industry-leading EDA portfolio for semiconductor design by bringing together our premier hardware-assisted verification portfolio with its industry-leading software debugging technologies. As semiconductors represent a core vertical for our technology strategy, this enables customers to test and optimize their products even before the actual chip is produced – significantly reducing development time,” said Cedrik Neike, Member of the Managing Board of Siemens AG and President Digital Industries.

> “Lauterbach is a remarkable success story, written in Germany for the global semiconductor industry. We will build on the impressive legacy that founders Lothar and Stephan Lauterbach and their team have achieved over the past decades and are very pleased to welcome the Lauterbach group to Siemens. We are also delighted that Stephan Lauterbach and Thomas Ullmann will continue their work as part of Siemens following the closing of the transaction.”

> Lauterbach and Siemens solutions are already used by numerous mutual customers. The increasing complexity of modern semiconductors and embedded software, driven by trends such as artificial intelligence, software-defined vehicles, Internet of Things (IoT), multi-core architectures, cybersecurity and functional safety, is leading to greater convergence between hardware and software development. On that basis, Siemens expects significant revenue synergies from the transaction.

### Airbus — 2026-11-11 — «The Cathay Group orders 14 additional Airbus aircraft»

> “The A330 and A320 aircraft families have been serving the Cathay Group well, and we are pleased to be adding more of these state-of-the-art, fuel-efficient aircraft to our fleet,” said Cathay Chief Operations and Service Delivery Officer Alex McGowan. “This latest order for 14 additional A330-900s and A321neos enables us to further expand and upgrade our fleet, supporting not only our regional operations across Asia-Pacific, but also providing greater flexibility to operate longer flights, further strengthening connectivity at our home hub, Hong Kong.”

> “This additional order from the Cathay Group, an experienced operator of the A330ceo and the A320 Family, is a strong endorsement of the value these aircraft bring in supporting the airline’s growth,” said Benoit de Saint-Exupery, Airbus EVP Sales of the Commercial Aircraft business. “Together the A330-900 and A321neo aircraft give the airline the flexibility to match capacity to demand, bringing versatility while benefiting from lower fuel burn and the efficiencies of a streamlined Airbus fleet. We are proud to support the Cathay Group through its exciting next stage of fleet renewal and growth.”
